cinderfall.incomplete: P-BUCKET3. AdjustDegreeOfSuccess only adjusts the actor's own checks (its selectors are things like strike-attack-roll, saving-throw, skill-check -- all rolled by this actor); there's no selector for downgrading an incoming attacker's degree of success against you.
